stdout:
What the studio sends is held to the rules
  ok    a plain request is read, the amount in cents and the total worked out
  ok    several lines, an amount typed the European way, quantities multiplied
  ok    refused: no address, no line, an empty line, a bad amount
  ok    the total is held to a product's own price bounds
  ok    a due date only from today to the last day the link works
  ok    at most three reminders, and never without the creator's word that the person agreed
  ok    every problem has a sentence, in US English, with no urgency

The counts are enforced in code
  ok    a request is kept, open, for 45 days
  ok    its room in the data room was taken before it was written
  ok    one of the store's requests, found only under its store
  ok    the plan's open requests are all in use
  ok    one more is refused, with a sentence, and leaves nothing behind
  ok    one person keeps at most MAX_PER_PERSON requests in a store
  ok    a store with no plan cannot keep any

The email: from the store's own emails for the month, and plain
  ok    it goes, and takes one of the store's emails
  ok    to the person, saying who asks and how much
  ok    with the lines, the link, that nothing is charged unless they pay, and who sends it
  ok    and no urgency, no late fee
  ok    written down as sent, with its first reminder on its day
  ok    not again within a day by hand
  ok    with the store's emails used, it does not go, and the creator is told why

Paid through the same checkout as any sale
  ok    payment request is charged on this creator's connected account
  ok    the platform test credential acts on this connected account
  ok    payment request has no platform destination or transfer routing
  ok    Stripe's page on the creator's account
  ok    one payment of its lines, to the person it was sent to
  ok    marked as this request, for the sales list, the sweep and the receipt
  ok    its order admitted before Stripe's page opened
  ok    nothing that adds to the buyer's amount: no shipping, no code box, no fee on them
  ok    back to the request's own page
  ok    never open past the request's own time
  ok    a second press opens the same checkout, never a second beside it
  ok    the plan's share is set on it the way it is on any sale
  ok    and with the share on, a Store plan's 6.25% of the total would be the fee
  ok    sales tax and Stripe's invoice where the creator switched them on
  ok    past the plan's orders, it says the store is not taking new payments, and nothing opens

Back from paying: paid once, a receipt once, one order
  ok    not paid yet: still open
  ok    paid, with what Stripe took and its payment
  ok    the receipt goes, to the person, and the order is counted
  ok    the receipt names the payment and links to its printable page
  ok    never twice
  ok    a paid request is no longer open, and sends no reminder
  ok    and its page takes no second payment

A refund on Stripe shows
  ok    in part: still paid, with what was refunded
  ok    in full: refunded, kept so

Reminders: on their day, as many as asked, never after it closes
  ok    nothing before its day
  ok    the first reminder on its day, saying it is a reminder
  ok    once
  ok    one that cannot go is not sent and waits a day
  ok    not within that day
  ok    then it goes
  ok    no more than the two asked for
  ok    and at most 4 emails in all, by hand too
  ok    an expired request takes no payment and no reminder

An uncertain provider response keeps its source without another send
  ok    HTTP500 is not confirmed non-acceptance or permission to repeat
  ok    the payment request source is retained for reconciliation

Cancel, delete, and deleting the person
  ok    an open request cannot be deleted before it is canceled
  ok    canceled: its link takes no payment
  ok    then deleted
  ok    deleting the person deletes every request of theirs in that store
  ok    and the person register and the erasure say so

Said where creators and buyers read it
  ok    the privacy policy says what is kept about the person and how it is deleted
  ok    the terms say a request goes only to someone who agreed to pay
  ok    the help center and the feature page say what it does
